prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a rear-end collision claim. Injury: knee injury. The claimant is represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1182; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Claim opened following a rear-end collision at a signalized intersection. Insured vehicle was struck from behind by the third-party vehicle. Both drivers reported to have exited their vehicles, no ambulance on scene. Police report requested. Photos of both vehicles uploaded to the file.

Entry 2: Third-party claimant reports knee injury from impact, states knee struck the dashboard. Claimant has retained counsel, who has requested all future contact be routed through the firm. Recorded that direct contact with claimant has ceased. Acknowledgment letter sent to counsel's office.

Entry 3: Spoke with defense counsel's office regarding the scope of the knee injury claim. Counsel has provided initial medical records covering an urgent care visit following the collision. Imaging referenced in the records has been requested. Reserve under review pending receipt of the full treatment history.

Entry 4: Vehicle inspection completed on the claimant's vehicle. Rear bumper damage and trunk panel deformation documented. Repair estimate received and reviewed. Noted that the claimant's account of the knee impact is consistent with interior damage photos showing contact marks on the lower dash panel.

Entry 5: Received updated medical summary from counsel indicating ongoing physical therapy for the knee. Requested an independent medical review of the records to assess treatment necessity. File flagged for supervisor review at next reserve meeting. Follow-up scheduled with counsel to confirm receipt of outstanding records.
